review_text: I visited Tbrews Cafe last Saturday while waiting for a friend nearby, and it turned out to be such a nice little find. It’s a small, quaint coffee shop along Obrero, perfect if you just want a quiet place to relax. The air conditioning was a lifesaver on such a hot day. I ordered a cold Spanish latte with less condensed milk, and the barista followed my instructions perfectly. The coffee was really good...smooth and just the right sweetness. I also appreciated the ambiance. The music was light and not too loud, making it a great spot for solitude or just unwinding. They have outlets too, so it’s a good place if you need to work or charge your devices. I’ve heard their pastas and sandwiches are worth trying, so I might come back for those next time. Overall, I really enjoyed my short stay, definitely a chill spot I’d visit again.

Went here May 3, 2026. Been meaning to try coming back here because it was peaceful. Entered around 7pm so almost 8. Got the ₱165 Sagada by Cup of Joe, the drink helped a lot with staying up but I did expect the coffee beans used where from Sagada which was not. I would the bathroom is in the backroom or yard so wheelchaired customers can't. They also sell stickers.

I recently visited this place out of curiosity and I had a great time. The iced coffee I ordered was really good, and the service was amazing (hospitable and quick to serve my order). The atmosphere of the place is unique with a warm and cozy tone, which makes you want to stay a bit longer. This place is definitely worth the visit.

Always my go-to homey cafe in Davao! Owner is super friendly and kind, with great recommendations if you like customizing your drink. Highly recommend In The Dark for hot drink while Icarus and Hany Latte, if you prefer iced. In the Dark is the only mocha you need. 💘 There's also snacks to go with your coffee like pasta and sandwiches; their French Toast is a personal fave. Matcha and non coffee options are also available. Please visit!

Love this café so much! It has such a homey and warm vibe that makes you feel comfortable right away. The staff are very friendly and even ask about your preferences, which I really appreciate. Both the Matcha Latte and Sea Salt Latte are a solid 10/10 for me. Their toast is also a must-try — super soft and not too sweet, just perfect. Definitely one of my favorites!

As do coffee shops offering the Pumpkin Spice latte as seasonal, this cafe has it as already part of their menu. How rare is that? The smooth texture did not hit MY level of spiciness though. It may be just me but I did not taste a hint of pumpkin spice in it. The Icarus was rich, creamy and delicious. Both drinks were surprisingly not sweet which was actually just divine. Though parking is a bit of a letdown, I am still willing to visit again. Place was uncluttered and relaxing.

My first review and it’s for this café. Super LOVED the place. The vibes are warm and the place is so cozy. The owner was so nice and we felt welcomed by the barista too! The food and drinks are reasonably nice and also student-friendly! Would love to come back again. 🫶🏼

It’s been a while since I last came by, but walking in felt cozy and welcoming. The owner is sweet and really takes her time making each drink special.
